label: Mediabibliotek — Vercel Blob
summary: Hosted storage for the site's own heavy media (MP4 video, large photo sets) on Vercel Blob, served from the storage CDN instead of the repo. Ships a server helper (listMedia/uploadMedia), a read-only /api/media route and a <MediaGallery /> grid. Demo mode (mock: seed): without a real BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN the gallery renders the shipped seedMedia with a discreet <MediaConfigNotice /> — no crash, no storage call. uploadMedia is server-only and must never be exposed without owner authentication.
summarySv: Plats för sajtens egna filmer och tyngre bilder — till exempel referensbilder, produktfoton eller en presentationsfilm — så att de laddar snabbt utan att ligga i själva sajtkoden. Ett galleri visar filerna automatiskt. Tills lagringen är kopplad visas exempelbilder och en exempelfilm i demoläge, med en tydlig notis; inga filer kan läggas upp förrän kopplingen är klar.

envVars.purpose: Read/write token for the project's Vercel Blob store (created automatically when a Blob store is attached under the project's Storage tab; format vercel_blob_rw_…). Tagged feature-runtime: isMediaStorageConfigured() gates every storage call, so a missing or placeholder value renders seedMedia + MediaConfigNotice instead of crashing.

notes: New 2026-09-02 (owner decision: small-business owners need a home for heavy media). Keyless typecheck + the seed/demo gallery are covered by unit tests; a live list against a real Blob store in a deployed preview is still required before verificationStatus becomes accepted. Deliberately ships NO public upload route — uploads require an owner-authenticated caller.
